text:
ashley: Heads up — started seeing a small spike in gang pod evictions in ap-southeast1 around 01:10 UTC, looks correlated with spot instance drains + affinity shuffle. Not huge but steady.

devin: how small? numbers?

ashley: ~12 evictions last 30m across 3 jobs, several pods failed the gang coalesce probe and got preempted. Warm pools untouched.

cheng: past logs show `Error: failed to allocate contiguous slots` from scheduler at 01:08. paste from kube-scheduler logs:```
I0301 01:08:12.345678 1 scheduler.go:123] binding pod default/job-a-0 to node gpu-node-23
E0301 01:08:12.346000 1 allocator.go:77] failed to pack gang: insufficient contiguous slots with matching labels
```

kai: likely the fractional-gpu allocator + our affinity label rollouts interacting with spot churn. when a spot drains it fragments adjacent slots; fractional packing can't remap across taints quickly.

devin: can we temp disable fractional packing for the affected nodepool? or expand warm pool size?

ashley: disabling fractional globally risky. We could bump warm-pool capacity by 10% and adjust `--gang-coalesce-window` to 5s for a canary.

cheng: test command to change scheduler flag in staging: `kubectl -n kube-system edit deploy kube-scheduler` and update args, or use kops/helm patch for rollout.

ops-bot: [autoscaler] Detected spot-instance termination event for asg-ap-southeast1-gpu (instance i-0abcd1234) at 01:05 UTC. Triggering scale-in reconciliation.

kai: ops-bot confirms spot churn timing lines up. Suggest a two-step workaround: 1) increase warm pool by 10% in ap-southeast1, 2) set `--gang-coalesce-window=5s` on scheduler in that region only via nodepool annotation override.

devin: ok -- for quick test I'll patch the staging scheduler and run a synthetic gang job to validate no regressions. if green, can push the warm-pool bump to prod for ap-southeast1.

ashley: cost question — bumping warm pool ~10% vs eviction cost (job retries). rough numbers?

cheng: rough calc: current warm pool 50 GPUs, +10% = +5 GPUs. at $2.40/hr per GPU (pre-commit), ~ $12/hr extra. Eviction/retry cost estimated ~ $40/hr in wasted GPU time during spikes. net win if spike persists >20min.

devin: good enough for canary. I'll run patch in staging now. pinging @kai for rollout plan. :thumbsup:

kai: will prepare cluster-ops rollout doc and a revert plan. also adding a brief alert rule tweak so we don't spam incidents for tiny blips — set threshold to 5 evictions / 15m per AZ before firing.

ashley: assigned follow-up to myself to monitor for 2h after rollout, will post summary. thanks.

sre-bot: [alert] Increased eviction rate detected in ap-southeast1 (evictions: 12 in 30m). Logged incident INC-20240301-72.

ashley: noted, will update INC-20240301-72 with canary steps.

devin: staging results: synthetic gang job passed with coalesce-window=5s and no evictions in 30m. ready for prod patch if ops approves.

kai: ops approves for limited rollout to ap-southeast1 only. schedule 02:45 UTC.

ashley: thanks team — I'll run the prod warm-pool bump + scheduler flag change at 02:45, will post back with metrics. :eyes:
